facts.fact: The Goat's Teeth is a spine of steep rock on the south-east shoulder of the Long Saddle: three ledges, two ropes' worth of down-climbing and an ice chimney, dropping about two thousand feet to the Neshar side below the third bend. A pair needs a day and a half, Rohan one-armed about two. Jassi named it and hated it.

Rohan's grandfather was a warden of the Shilak post sixty winters ago, before the post had a hall. He went out in a night storm to check the cairns for a lost party and was found at the thaw. The Closing Law was written the next spring. Rohan believes it was an accident.
Rohan says he has buried seven wardens and that Pritam would open the Shilak to his grain wagons by midwinter if the Closing Law lapsed.

Meera buys a second question round for both leads by burning a wet juniper deadfall branch, which is not part of the counted dry bundle. Rohan then burns one dry stick for silence about the fines, leaving twelve.
Meera's answer to what she would do if the law were gone is 'Sleep.' Rohan's silence on the fines confirms to her that he pays them.
Meera tells Rohan that at the thaw he will deliver her, so she will not kiss him. She says it deliberately so he chooses with open eyes before the Teeth. Rohan's eyes go still on the word 'me'.
